stem: How does this line support a major theme of the drama?
instruction:
Read line 12.

MOTHER ANT: Hormiguita, your father is right. As an ant, you need to help with the work of the anthill.

options.label: A
options.text: By emphasizing that children and parents should do activities together

options.label: B
options.text: By explaining that the demands of some tasks can result in little time for rest

options.label: C
options.text: By highlighting that children need to learn from their parents’ wisdom

options.label: D
options.text: By suggesting that everyone’s efforts are needed to achieve a common goal

visual_elements: MOTHER ANT: Hormiguita, your father is right. As an ant, you need to help with the work of the anthill.
